_doc: The slot of OpenBuilds V-Slot linear rail: a T-slot whose mouth is a V, so that a wheel with a V rim runs in it. Opening (6.25), width under the lips (11) and the height under the lips (4.30) are printed on OpenBuilds' drawings; the lip, the V's width and angle, the floor and the flanks are scaled off them, and say so. OpenBuilds shares its design work under CC BY-SA 4.0: dimensions are taken, the shape is not, and the kit draws the slot from these figures. The drawn slot leaves out the small V mark in the middle of the floor. Clones are sold under the same name with other figures: measure yours.
name: slot-6-openbuilds

opening.rule: Between the lips below the V, 6.25 on the drawing
opening.source: OpenBuilds, dimension drawing in the gallery of its product page "V-Slot 20x40 Linear Rail" (image 13605), https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/ as the Internet Archive saved it on 2025-12-07, https://web.archive.org/web/2025/https://us.openbuilds.com/v-slot-20x40-linear-rail/

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the underside of the lip: 1.79 by the drawing's scale. Not dimensioned: the drawing prints only the 4.30 below it

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips, 11 on the drawing

nut_family.rule: It takes the tee nuts sold for V-Slot (M5): the cavity is narrower and shallower than a 20 mm T-slot's (11 against 12), so not every 20 series nut goes in
